SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I am indebted to you, Kyousuke-shi...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] You have given me great aid, and yet, it will all amount to nothing...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] But it hasn't amounted to anything yet!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] So that's how strong your will is.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Just you thinking like that makes me feel blessed.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'm not just thinking it. I intend to do something.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Those are very promising words.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Though, my spirit is like a dying flame in the wind now..

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] It's the same even if you have results. There's nothing that can be done.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Haha... It is truly a vain effort.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I think no matter how much I apologize, I have to take my hat off to you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] But, I haven't really done anything...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Even so, the fact that you tried to help me remains.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] It ends today. You are officially a free man.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Saori...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...After the wedding... I will send you a letter...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] A letter showing how... happy I am with him.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Then I'll rip it up and eat it before even reading!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Kyousuke-shi, that's what white goats and black goats do.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Exactly when has my friend turned into a goat?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] If you still think of me as a friend, then stop making jokes that I can't laugh at.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Where do you find fun in deceiving your friend and making him worried?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I'm not deceiving you... I am trying to show you my sincerity.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You're saying you have the resolve for marriage?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] If I do not have resolve, then I cannot progress as a samurai.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Wait, you are an otaku, not a samurai.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] That ends today too. From now on, I'm a bride.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] A very happy bride...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I don't need your fake sincerity!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Sincerity is thinking about how the other person feels, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] If you stop being an otaku, and stop being our friends...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Do you really think you're doing it for our sake?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...My apologies.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'm tired of hearing you apologize!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Try saying something different from time to time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Say "I'm relying on you!" or "Please lend me a hand!" or something like that!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Please don't give up! If you give up, then it's all over!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...have heard...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Saori?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] How many times have I heard you say, "Don't give up?"

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...Though, it is strange. I have not gotten tired of hearing it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Don't apologize. You haven't done anything wrong.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I haven't done anything right, either.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Don't be so self-degrading. You're doing the best you can.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Fufu... You are always like this.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Ha... Hahaha!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] W-What is it? Suddenly laughing like that...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Well, when one considers it, it is marriage! Every girl's ultimate dream.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] The moment I become a bride, I will be happier than anyone!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Happier... than anyone...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Saori...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...I am truly sorry.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Why are you apologizing...? You haven't done anything wrong yet...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] You have gone this far with me, not anyone else, but me...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] If I think about it, I have only been relying on you.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I think it is time to repay my debt.
